identity.title: Bounded Near-Term Gamma Discovery, Source Fee Provenance and Transport Evidence Correction
identity.objective: Correct the merged category-neutral 120-minute scratch research scanner after one public run observed 300 older long-dated markets, 300 absent top-level categories, no books and offset300 transport unavailable. Add time-filtered Gamma discovery using documented end_date_min/end_date_max, truthful metadata/category/economic evidence fallback, safer bounded transport failure classes and cold replay with legacy evidence provenance. Keep USD2-5 fee-inclusive cap, 120-minute metadata-only semantics, no real acquisition during implementation, no provider/trading/canonical writes.
